title: Heading Outline
description: Prevents a heading structure screen reader users can't navigate by showing the live outline of a Markdown draft or any DOM region and flagging skipped levels (drawn as dashed ghost rows), extra or missing H1s, empty headings, bold text posing as a heading and paragraph-length headings, with a one-tap "Make it H3" fix and rows that jump to the heading.
stops: Skipped heading levels confuse screen readers
